episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Margaret Hale and her parents are forced to leave their idyllic life and move to Milton.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Tensions rise as the workers strike over pay. Margaret is caught between the workers and their employer when she steps in to try and protect Thornton from violence.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Thornton is heartbroken and humiliated, but at least the strike is over.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Will Thornton and Margaret meet again and finally acknowledge their love for one another?
